backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three simulation-speed-related features to frontend/src/App.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists brief summaries of key frontend files including App.tsx, index.css, and useQueries.ts.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables and dark-mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML page that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main Game of Life component handling grid logic, rendering, controls, zoom, and adjustable tick interval.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook creating and refreshing a backend actor tied to Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity provider and hook managing auth client, login flow, stored identities, and status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS variables and global styles for the frontend including light/dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entrypoint initializing QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling OKLCH color tokens, dark mode, plugins, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s simulation requirements, UI controls, initialization/reset rules, and known deployment issues. Contains feature descriptions for a grid-based Game of Life variant with speed, zoom, and control behaviors.
